caption: A metal water bottle packed with ice sits on a gym bench, and a wet patch spreads on the bench beneath it.

sa.check: A metal water bottle stands on a gym bench.
The droplets run down to its base.
A wet patch spreads on the bench beneath it.
The bottle reads as packed with ice: frost or chill on its surface.
The beading comes first and the patch follows.

pc.expect: The beading and the patch only grow while the bottle stays cold.
pc.fail: The droplets shrink or go while the bottle stays cold and frosted; or the wet patch shrinks; or the bottle beads and dries in turn; or the droplets turn back into dry frost in the warm room.

pc.expect: The droplets run downward on the bottle to its base and the patch grows out from under it.
pc.fail: A droplet runs up the bottle; or water gathers on the cap and stays as a dome; or a drop leaves the bottle and rises; or the patch grows away from the bottle with no water running to it.

pc.expect: The water forms on the outside of the cold metal and the patch lies under the bottle where the runs reach the bench.
pc.fail: The water appears on the bench away from the bottle with none running there; or the bottle's own level drops as the patch grows; or beads form inside the bottle's mouth while its outside stays dry; or the bench stays dry under a bottle streaming with runs.

pc.expect: The beads behave as water on metal: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the bench darkens where it wets.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the metal; or the bench stays dry-looking under a spreading patch; or the beads stand as tall columns on the metal.

pc.expect: One bottle on one bench; the bottle keeps its shape and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The bottle changes shape; or a second bottle appears; or the cap passes into the bottle; or water passes out through the metal wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bottle's finish, the bench and the gym behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The bottle changes colour; or the bench changes pattern; or the gym's equipment rearranges.
